results.name: Each role sees only its relevant primary navigation; desktop has at most four choices
Worker account menu has seven useful actions, with no repeated bookings or marketing links
Every registered page and dynamic route dispatches to an existing page
Credentials opens the dedicated uploader and previews both PDF and image evidence
Menu keyboard open, tab boundary, Escape and close return focus correctly
Bookings API failures show an escaped explanation and retry instead of silently returning
All literal internal navigation destinations resolve and required local assets exist
Uploader opens when optional assistance is unavailable and returns directly to Credentials
Mixed upload results preserve successful files; retry only sends the failed file and refreshes the list
Leaving uploads or changing the signed-in person stops prepared files being sent
